run_train_net: run train_net.py with a config file to train a Detectron network model
run_train_net_skip_test: run train_net.py with --skip-test to train a model without running inference tests
run_train_net_multi_gpu: run train_net.py with --multi-gpu-testing to use multiple GPUs for model inference
test_model_inference: test a trained Detectron model by running inference on the final checkpoint
parse_args_train: parse command line arguments for training including config file, skip test, and multi GPU options
